assets.name: Neon sign Circuit
assets.author: MintoDog
modifications: decoded from Ogg Vorbis 44100 Hz stereo
time-stretched from 145 to 144 BPM with ffmpeg atempo=144/145 (pitch preserved)
re-aligned to the measured downbeat (-8.7 ms after stretching) so beat 0 is at 0 s
cut to 60 bars (100.000 s) with a 10 ms loop-seam crossfade
normalised to -16 LUFS integrated (-3.4 dB)
encoded AAC-LC 128kbps stereo 44100 Hz in M4A

assets.name: Relay courier body (Superhero Male) with race animation clips
assets.author: Quaternius
modifications: removed hair and eye meshes (covered by the procedural helmet)
removed all textures and the TEXCOORD_0..3, COLOR_0 and COLOR_1 attributes; the race draws a procedural suit shader instead

copied 10 clips by bone name onto the body skeleton and renamed them: Idle_Loop->idle, Crouch_Idle_Loop->ride, NinjaJump_Start->jump-start, NinjaJump_Idle_Loop->air, NinjaJump_Land->land, Slide_Start->slide-start, Slide_Loop->slide, Hit_Chest->hit, OverhandThrow->throw, Yes->victory
kept bone rotation channels only, plus pelvis translation rescaled to the body's rest pelvis height; dropped leaf-bone channels
welded, resampled animation keys (tolerance 0.0008), pruned, deduplicated
quantized and compressed with EXT_meshopt_compression (medium)
